AboutDescription: An unofficial, community-made mod launcher for Distant Worlds 2: manage Steam Workshop and local mods, load order, profiles and conflicts, run code mods, and publish your own mods to the Workshop. Open source under the MIT License.
AboutReleasesTooltip: Open the releases page in your browser to check for a newer version
AboutDisclaimer: This is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CodeForce, Slitherine, or Matrix Games.
AboutDiscordText: Questions, problems and mod talk: join the Distant Worlds 2 Discord and find the #mods channel.

Steam accepted the request to unsubscribe from "{Mod}".

PublishAboutToRunUpdate: This updates the Mod's existing Steam Workshop item, by talking to Steam directly through your currently logged-in Steam client - no separate login needed. Make sure Steam is running before continuing.

"{Tag}" is not a tag the catalog knows yet. Add it as a new tag?

SettingsDescriptionExtensionTooltip: File extension for the description file of a mod that does not name one yet (.bbcode by default; a dot is added if you leave it out). Mods that already name their description file keep it.
SettingsAutoSaveProfileOnLaunch: Save mod profile changes on launch
SettingsAutoSaveProfileOnLaunchTooltip: When you start the game with unsaved changes to the mod profile, save them without asking. Off: ask each time.
SettingsAutoSaveProfileOnExit: Save mod profile changes on exit
SettingsAutoSaveProfileOnExitTooltip: When you close the launcher with unsaved changes to the mod profile, save them without asking. Off: ask each time.
SettingsGameMonitorTooltip: Which monitor the game opens on, and so which video card draws it. Automatic leaves the game where it puts itself, which is the main monitor. The game then opens on that monitor at its real size, without showing up on another one first, and stays there at any Windows display scale. Windows only.
SettingsClearCrashIndication: Clear the game's crash prompt on launch
SettingsClearCrashIndicationTooltip: Before starting the game, delete the marker it leaves after a crash, hang or kill, so it does not ask about the last session. Off by default.
SettingsSkipSplashTooltip: Start the game with its own --skip-splash switch, so the splash screen is not shown. Off by default.
ClearCrashIndicationFailed: The game's crash marker could not be deleted, so the game may ask about the last session: {Problem}
SettingsOpenSteamPageTooltip: What to do with the item's Steam page once a publish succeeds. A failed publish, or a publish with a warning, always tells you.
SettingsAutoUpdateDescription: Update the Steam description when newer
SettingsAutoUpdateDescriptionTooltip: When you publish an update and the description differs from the Steam page, send it too. Turn this off to handle the description yourself (the cloud-upload button in the publish dialog); it is then never sent with a publish. A first publish always sends it.
SettingsSteamLinksTooltip: Publishing lists the mods yours depends on on its Steam page (Required items), so players see them and Steam offers them. A dependency's "steamLink" in dw2modlauncher.json overrides these choices.
SettingsLinkOptionalModsTooltip: Link the mods yours merely works better with, not only the ones it requires. A dependency with "steamLink": false is never linked.
SettingsTrimSteamLinks: Remove links it no longer lists
SettingsTrimSteamLinksTooltip: Publishing also removes Steam dependency links to mods that are not in the mod's dependency list. Off: links added by hand on Steam stay.
PublishLinked: Linked on the Steam page as required items: {Mods}.
PublishUnlinked: Removed from the Steam page's required items: {Mods}.
PublishUnlinkable: Not linked on the Steam page because they have no Workshop item yet: {Mods}.
SettingsSteamHelperProcess: Run Steam calls in a separate helper process
SettingsSteamHelperProcessTooltip: On (default): each Steam call runs in a short-lived helper process, so Steam only sees the game running during the call. Off: the launcher stays connected to Steam as Distant Worlds 2 while it runs, so Steam shows the game as running. Takes effect immediately.
PublishNoteDescriptionSent: The description WILL be sent to Steam.
PublishNoteDescriptionOff: The description will NOT be sent: automatic description updates are off in Settings.
PublishNoteDescriptionSame: The description will NOT be sent: it already matches the Steam page.
PublishStrayImagesWarning: Image files in the mod folder that the mod does not use (only the preview image is used) but that would be uploaded to Steam with it: {Count}.
PublishPreviewResizeNameTaken: {File} already exists in the mod folder and will be replaced.
PublishPreviewResizeNameBad: That is not a valid file name.
PublishPreviewResizeFailed: {File} could not be made smaller than 1 MiB without becoming tiny. It will be used as it is.
PublishBundlesNone: No bundles found in the mod folder.
PublishBundlesMissingTooltip: Listed in mod.json but not found in the mod folder.
PublishBundlesRemoveConfirm:
These bundles are listed in mod.json but are missing from the mod folder. Saving removes them from the list:

{Bundles}
PublishInjectedDllsWarnNoOptions: This mod defines settings, but its DLL only has Init(), so it can never receive them. Add InitWithOptions(string) to the Entry class, or remove the settings schema.
PublishInjectedDllsProblemNotManaged: Not a managed (.NET) DLL. Only DLLs with an Entry point belong in a mod folder, so this one will not be loaded.
PublishInjectedDllsProblemNoEntryType: No Entry class found. Only DLLs with an Entry point belong in a mod folder, so this one will not be loaded.
PublishInjectedDllsProblemNotPublicTopLe: Has an Entry class, but it must be public and top-level (not nested). This DLL will not be loaded.
PublishInjectedDllsProblemNotStatic: Has an Entry class, but it must be static. This DLL will not be loaded.
PublishInjectedDllsProblemNoInitMethod: Has an Entry class, but no public static Init() or InitWithOptions(string) method. This DLL will not be loaded.
PublishInjectedDllsTooltip: DLLs the launcher will inject into the game for this mod: any DLL with a public static Entry class (Init or InitWithOptions). Override with dw2modlauncher.json.
PublishCompatibleWithTooltip: Mods that change the same parts of the game as this one and that you have checked it works with. The launcher stops warning about the overlap with them. A version means the check holds for that version only.
PublishCompatibleAdd: Add a mod you have checked this one works with
PublishCompatibleUpdate: Compatible with version {Version}, the one installed now
PublishDependenciesTooltip: Mods this one needs or works better with. Required ones warn before launch when missing. Load order and the oldest version are enforced when the player presses Play.
PublishDependencyRequiredTooltip: The mod does not work without this one: the launcher warns before launch when it is missing.
PublishDependencyOrderTooltip: Whether this mod must load after or before the other one (when the other is enabled).
PublishDependencyMinVersionTooltip: The oldest version of the other mod that works.
PublishDependencySteamLinkTooltip: List this mod on the Steam page as a required item when publishing. Starts from the launcher's Settings (required mods always; optional ones if "Link optional mods too" is on); a different choice is saved with this dependency. Unavailable when Steam is off.
PublishDependencyPickNote: Pick the installed mod this one depends on. It is added as optional; set the options in its row.
PublishDependencyNothingToAdd: Every other installed mod is already listed.
PublishCompatiblePickNote: Choose the mod this one is compatible with. Its current version is recorded.
PublishCompatibleNothingToAdd: There are no other mods to add.
PublishCompatibleCautionHeader:
Installed mods that overlap with this one and are not marked compatible yet:
{Mods}
PublishReadingVisibility: Reading the item's visibility from Steam...
MarkUpToDateTooltip: Updates the launcher's local records to say the mod's current files are what is on the targets you publish to (the Steam Workshop and/or GitHub), even though nothing is sent. Use it when the changes are not worth a release (a reworded changelog, a recompile with identical behaviour), or to start tracking a GitHub release made outside the launcher. From then on only edits made after this show as modified. The Workshop item and the release themselves are not touched.
ConfirmMarkUpToDate:
Record the current files of "{Mod}" as what is on {Targets}?

Nothing is uploaded or changed there; only this launcher's local records change, and the next real publish still sends everything as usual.
ConfirmMarkUpToDateCount:
Record the current files of "{Mod}" as what is on {Targets}?

Changed files that will stop showing as modified: {Count}. Nothing is uploaded or changed there; only this launcher's local records change, and the next real publish still sends everything as usual.
MarkUpToDateNothingToMark: {Mod} has nothing to mark up to date on the targets you publish to.
MarkUpToDateFailed:
Could not update the local record:
{Problem}
MarkedUpToDateStatus: {Mod} is now recorded as up to date.
MarkUpToDateNotTracked: {Mod} cannot be marked up to date: it has no Workshop id, so there is no published record to update.
MarkUpToDateNothing: {Mod} has nothing to mark up to date (state: {State}).
MarkUpToDateStillChanged:
The record for {Mod} was updated, but these files still differ from it:
{Files}

SettingsPublishToTooltip: GitHub releases: Publish offers a GitHub release and each mod's releases repository; a mod is released on GitHub only when it names one. GitHub releases need the GitHub command-line tool (gh) and your login on this computer. Publishing to the Steam Workshop is on whenever Use Steam is ticked.
SettingsUseSteamTooltip: Tick if you have the game through Steam. Steam Workshop mods are listed, checked for updates and published to, and Steam is asked about your mods. Untick if you have the game elsewhere: the launcher then never contacts Steam and ignores any Workshop folder. On Linux, starting the game from the launcher needs Steam.
